Q: Error in installing fast text-Could not build wheels for fasttext, which is required to install pyproject.toml-based projects A:

I believe this is a duplicate of ERROR: Could not build wheels for fasttext, which is required to install pyproject.toml-based projects which basically asks the same question where fasttext can't build wheels.

Basically, use this instead: pip install fasttext-wheel

fasttext tries to compile C++ code from source, which requires a full MSVC build environment. Using fasttext-wheel instead works because it provides pre‑compiled Windows wheels.

Q: How to configure tanstack router, using feature based folder structure A:

You can use the parameter routeFileIgnorePattern on vite.config.ts

You can pass a regular expression as a parameter as explained on the documentation

Here is an example of my code that will allow the folders /components and /hooks and the files functions.ts and queryParams.ts

  routeFileIgnorePattern: '((components|hooks)|functions\\.ts|queryParams\\.ts)',
